7p65: Competency in Business Data Analytics is now a staple in every organization as a result of the dependence on data in decision-making, the growth of e-commerce and the increase in utilization of communication channels including social networks. This program focuses on the business and management side of business data analytics. The skills acquired in this program will be more focused on the management of data and systems as opposed to the technical aspects such as software development, and quantitative analysis only.
